title: A work order holding an inactive part can still be invoiced
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-INVOICE-01) is tracked at {Location-A} with Sell Price $20.00.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is complete and ready to invoice; its line {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL INVOICE line") holds {Part-A}, quantity 1, picked.
  • {Part-A} was set inactive after the work order was completed and before it was invoiced.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1} and its Finance tab.
  2. Click "Create Invoice".
  3. Read the invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The invoice is created and {Work-order-1} reads Invoiced.
  • Step 3: The invoice lists {Part-A}, 1 × $20.00 = $20.00.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S9-E3, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas 13 Oct copy: no board shows this.
